_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

From the Mountains#000.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs om fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#000.dst: Mmf! Humfain! Ma maifson brfûle! Cherfche de l'aifde, le feu s'arrêfte pfas!
From the Mountains#000.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#001.src: It's impossible to understand what language this man's speaking, but he's pointing to the house behind him. Is there something that can translate, maybe?
From the Mountains#001.dst: Impossible de comprendre la langue de cet homme, mais il montre la maison derrière lui. Y a-t-il peut-être de quoi traduire?

From the Mountains#002.src: Arnod keeps on pointing at his house. Maybe he needs something that's in there?
From the Mountains#002.dst: Arnod ne cesse de montrer sa maison. Il a peut-être besoin de quelque chose à l'intérieur?

From the Mountains#003.src: Arnod takes his dentures, and slides them back in his mouth.
From the Mountains#003.dst: Arnod prend son dentier et le remet dans sa bouche.

From the Mountains#004.src: Go, human! Find someone who can help! I'm not going to wait for my house to be burnt to a crisp!
From the Mountains#004.dst: Va, l'humain! Trouve quelqu'un qui peut aider! Je ne vais pas attendre que ma maison soit réduite en cendres!

From the Mountains#005.src: Hm...where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#005.dst: Hm... où vais-je trouver de l'aide, maintenant- Mh? Tu es un de ces humains, pas vrai? Tu aurais-
From the Mountains#005.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#006.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there... Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#006.dst: Bah, on verra sur place... Oh, ce que je fais ici? Oui, je ne ressemble sans doute pas à ce que tu as l'habitude de voir. Eh bien, je suis un nain.
From the Mountains#006.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#007.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh...that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#007.dst: ...et il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu. Ça, euh... ça ressemble un peu trop à chez moi, et je suis presque sûr que ça ne devrait pas.
From the Mountains#007.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#008.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-lighting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#008.dst: C'est cette maison, hm? Bon, je vais voir ce que je peux faire. Je ne pourrai peut-être pas l'éteindre, mais s'il se rallume, alors...
From the Mountains#008.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#009.src: Hm...didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#009.dst: Hm... je ne les pensais pas si loin, mais ce serait logique si...
From the Mountains#009.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#010.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else are harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#010.dst: Il y a un problème de marché noir à {p}. Ce qu'on ne trouve nulle part ailleurs est récolté dans les Heights pour sa grande valeur.
From the Mountains#010.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#011.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. We still have work to do.
From the Mountains#011.dst: La charrette est réparée et prête, tu as attrapé tous les Flerisi? Alors viens à la charrette. On a encore du travail.
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fires went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#012.dst: ...oh. Bon, je n'avais pas remarqué que le feu était allé AUSSI loin. C'est un problème, non?
From the Mountains#012.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#013.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed off cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#013.dst: Je t'explique: les Flerisi ne sont pas tous aussi petits que ceux d'ici. Ils se nourrissent de braises et de feu... Et pour causer autant de dégâts, eh bien...
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well...I got a free cart for the ride home. There's a thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#014.dst: Je vais demander à la garde locale s'ils ont trouvé les trafiquants. S'ils ont filé, eh bien... j'ai une charrette gratuite pour rentrer. J'ai une affaire à régler là-bas.
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#015.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#015.dst: Découvrez ce qui se passe en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#016.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#016.dst: Fu dois m'aifder! Je n'ai aufcune ifdée de quoi faifre!
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#017.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#017.dst: Trouvez dans la maison ce que veut Arnod.

From the Mountains#018.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#018.dst: ...bon, ça explique pourquoi tu n'as pas aidé. Mais, euh, l'INCENDIE FURIEUX t'a échappé, ou quoi?!
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#019.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#019.dst: Peu importe qui, trouve-moi de l'aide!! Que ce soit toi ou quelqu'un d'autre, je m'en fiche, mais il faut s'occuper de ce fichu feu qui se rallume sans cesse!
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#020.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#020.dst: Cherche dans {p} s'il le faut, mais dépêche-toi! Ma maison va finir en cendres si tu ne te presses pas!
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#021.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.
From the Mountains#021.dst: Trouvez quelqu'un à {p} qui peut vous aider avec le feu.

From the Mountains#022.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#022.dst: Hein? Une maison en feu? C'est sans doute plus urgent que ce que j'allais demander. C'est où?
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#023.dst: Oh, la vallée près de la porte? Je crois voir où c'est. Allons-y ensemble. Alors, raconte, que s'est-il passé exactement?
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said...what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#024.dst: Ah, tu es une sorte de mercenaire, et tu as trouvé la maison de cet homme en feu. Il a dit... quoi? Qu'elle se rallume toute seule? Ça n'a aucun sens.
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#025.dst: D'habitude, je vis à {p}, au-delà des canyons à l'est. Devine à quoi ressemble la région, vu le nom.
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#026.dst: Sans entrer dans les détails, il y a... quelques problèmes dans la façon dont c'est gouverné, et j'essayais de rallier des soutiens à {p}.
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#027.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#027.dst: Ça, euh. Bon, chez moi, j'ai l'habitude qu'on me rie au nez, mais je ne m'attendais pas à la même chose là-bas, juste avec des murs en quartz.
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#028.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#028.dst: J'allais te demander si tu pouvais m'aider d'une façon ou d'une autre, mais... bon, je sens la fumée d'ici. Chaque chose en son temps.
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#029.dst: Oui, ce feu n'a rien de naturel... Bon sang, on dirait presque un incendie criminel!
From the Mountains#029.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#030.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#030.dst: Aha! Voilà le problème. C'est juste un petit Fleris. Euh, je t'explique, ils vivent normalement dans les Heights.
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#031.dst: Plutôt affectueux, parfaits si on supporte la chaleur, mais loin de leurs monticules, ils prennent peur.
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: One fleris could've kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout...there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#032.dst: Un seul fleris a pu rallumer sans cesse la maison de cet homme, mais tous ces autres dégâts... il y en a sûrement d'autres là d'où il vient.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#033.dst: Allons parler au villageois dehors. Il a peut-être vu où sont partis les autres, ou d'où ils venaient.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#034.dst: Monsieur, j'ai compris pourquoi votre maison se rallumait et j'ai réglé le problème, mais dites-moi, avez-vous vu des trucs visqueux bouger par ici?
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#035.dst: Euh, je ne sais pas trop. J'ai essayé d'éteindre ma maison tant de fois que je n'ai pas vraiment fait attention!
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#036.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#036.dst: Je me souviens d'un truc genre goudron qui coulait des montagnes derrière chez moi, c'est tout!
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#037.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#037.dst: Ça me paraît assez concret. Allons voir ce qui se passe au sommet de la crête. Consulte ton livre si tu as besoin d'indications.
From the Mountains#037.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#038.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.
From the Mountains#038.dst: Allez au sentier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et suivez-le jusqu'au sommet de la montagne.

From the Mountains#039.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#039.dst: Hm, tu grimpes plutôt vite. Je pensais te devancer. Bon, ça ressemble à la zone brûlée de la vallée... Hm! Je m'en doutais.
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#040.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#040.dst: Je ne vois qu'une raison pour qu'il y ait autant de Flerisi par ici... Si ce chariot est renforcé, alors...
From the Mountains#040.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#041.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#041.dst: Bah, je le savais. Des trafiquants! Et des incompétents, en plus, vu qu'ils n'ont pas su garder ces bestioles.
From the Mountains#041.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#042.dst: Les Flerisi en font partie. Dans les Heights, on les garde comme animaux de compagnie. Assez amicaux, ils chauffent la maison et demandent peu de soins...
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#043.dst: ...Mais si on les éloigne d'un endroit chaud, ils brûlent tout. Et dire que- certains s'en servent comme armes. Ils ne savent pas laisser les choses tranquilles...
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#044.dst: Il va falloir attraper ces Flerisi. Tiens, prends ce filet. Pendant que tu les attrapes, je répare la charrette pour les y mettre ensuite.
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#045.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#045.dst: Capturez tous les Flerisi échappés et apportez-les à Axelus.

From the Mountains#046.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#046.dst: Je garderai les Flerisi près d'un petit feu pour les calmer, et je verrai à les ramener dans les Heights une fois tout ça fini.
From the Mountains#046.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#047.dst: Pour l'instant, j'aimerais trouver qui étaient ces trafiquants. Voyons s'ils ont laissé quelque chose à l'avant de la charrette.
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#048.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#048.dst: M'est avis que celui-là devient incontrôlable. Et c'est juste à côté de cette grande forêt. Ça pourrait poser problème si on le laisse faire.
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#049.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#049.dst: Il va falloir le traquer et le maîtriser. Allez, suis-moi. Je vais creuser jusqu'à la vallée. Regarde un nain au travail!
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#052.dst: Pas mal, hein? Bref, je ne sais pas à quoi sert cette énorme porte, mais notre ami Fleris semble l'avoir réquisitionnée pour un feu de joie.
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#053.dst: Au moins, dans cette grotte, c'est plus contenu que je ne pensais, mais il faut encore l'attraper. Passe devant. Je te suis.
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#054.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#054.dst: Qu'est-ce que...?! Il a enflammé les créatures de la grotte! Repousse-les!
From the Mountains#054.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#055.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#055.dst: Il en arrive d'autres! Fonce au fond de la grotte!
From the Mountains#055.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#057.dst: Si on s'arrête tous les deux, on va perdre trop de temps, et les trafiquants pourraient revenir!
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#058.dst: Écoute bien. Je m'occupe de ces trucs, toi, va après le Fleris. S'il est gros comme on le pense, ça ira de mieux en mieux- il devrait rétrécir si tu l'attaques!
From the Mountains#058.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#059.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#059.dst: Bien, place à la bagarre royale!
From the Mountains#059.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#061.dst: Ouf, tu vas bien! Roussi et couvert de suie, mais c'était à prévoir. Et le Fleris est maîtrisé! J'ai le filet, laisse-moi faire.
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#062.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#062.dst: Bon, c'était sans doute un travail ingrat, mais beaucoup le sont. Sortons d'ici. On parlera dehors.
From the Mountains#062.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#063.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#063.dst: Sortez de la grotte et parlez à Axelus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#064.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#064.dst: Je dis que c'est ingrat, mais ça ne m'arrêtera pas. Merci pour ton aide, l'humain- Seul, ça m'aurait dépassé.
From the Mountains#064.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#065.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#065.dst: Oh, où sont mes manières? Je ne me suis même pas présenté. Je m'appelle Axelus. Et toi?
From the Mountains#065.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#066.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#066.dst: {u}, hein? Je tâcherai de m'en souvenir. En attendant, prends cette armure pour ta peine. Bon voyage, {u}!
From the Mountains#066.speaker: Axelus
